subject: Hotel block details, late arrivals, and special-request rollup
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna@acmeevents.com>, Hilton Sales <hilton-sales@hilton.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hotel block details, late arrivals, and special-request rollup

Team / Jenna —

Thanks for the rate sheet call this morning. Attaching our proposed block manifest and the venue floorplan so we can align room types with breakout proximity. A few items we need confirmed ASAP to finalize the master bill and guest guidance: 

- Finalized cutoff date for rooms at contracted rate (we need to give speakers their booking window).
- Late/overnight arrivals: we expect ~18 people arriving after midnight on 11/15; request 24-hour check-in staffing and a secure key pick-up process.
- Laundry: can we arrange a single-day pick-up/drop-off service (bags labeled by last name) with one consolidated invoice to the master bill? Cost estimate requested.
- ADA rooms: please confirm how many true ADA-compliant rooms are guaranteed on the main tower vs overflow.
- Crib/cot policy (we have 4 requests) and pet policy exceptions for 2 service animals.
- Early breakfast boxes for 10 staff leaving before property breakfast hours.
- Parking passes and daily shuttle windows to/from downtown office (preferred shuttles at 7:15am and 8:00am).
- Bill routing: who should the master bill be made out to? (Acme Financial vs Redwood) — we will likely ask Acme to cover room nights, Redwood to cover incidentals.

Please attach any rate confirmation, resort fee waivers for executive rooms, and DocuSign link for the contract. Need these items by COB Monday (11/7) so payroll and travel can finalize.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Events, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189

Attachments: proposed_block_manifest.xlsx, venue_floorplan.pdf

From: Jenna Park <jenna@acmeevents.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Hilton Sales <hilton-sales@hilton.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 11:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hotel block details, late arrivals, and special-request rollup

Hi Ben —

Looping in the Hilton sales rep for specifics (see attached rate confirmation). Quick answers inline: 

- Cutoff date: 2027-11-10 for contracted rates; after that remaining rooms are released to public inventory.
- Late arrivals: property will staff 24-hour reception; they propose a sealed envelope key pick-up for late-check arrivals at bell desk and a guest QR code to validate identity.
- Laundry: on-site valet laundry available; Hilton can do a consolidated laundry pickup on 11/16 with an itemized invoice or a flat-block charge of $18/bag; vendor will do same-day turnaround if bags are in by 9am.
- ADA: Hilton guarantees 3 ADA king rooms on the main tower and can hold an additional 2 nearby accessible rooms in overflow (subject to final release).
- Cribs/cots: available at $30/night per crib; Hilton can pre-place 4 and bill to master.
- Pets: property accepts service animals only; they will provide documentation to support any exception.
- Early breakfasts: boxed continental options start at $12/box; can be delivered to lobby pickup or to meeting rooms at 6:00am.
- Shuttle: they can schedule two dedicated shuttles (7:10am and 7:55am) with 14-passenger vans. Parking passes: $22/day self-park; $34/day valet (can be consolidated on master).
- Resort/amenity fees: they are willing to waive resort fees for 4 executive rooms if the master bill is confirmed and certain F&B minimums are met.

Attached: Hilton-Rate-Confirm-ACME-Redwood.pdf and a preliminary contract for signature. DocuSign link below for the room block addendum. Please confirm master-bill recipient and a final headcount by 11/10 so I can lock ADA inventory and shuttle manifests.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/ACME-Redwood-Block-2027

Best,
Jenna Park
Senior Event Producer, Acme Events
jenna@acmeevents.com | +1 212-555-0142

Attachments: Hilton-Rate-Confirm-ACME-Redwood.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 08:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hotel block details, late arrivals, and special-request rollup

Thanks Jenna / team — a few quick clarifications from ops and exec support: 

- Please reserve one adjacent suite (CEO suite) for executive overflow nights (11/15–11/17). We will need a quiet floor for at least 6 senior execs to be distributed away from the main event noise.
- Dietary: two execs (Brad Stevens and Maria L.) have strict gluten-free + shellfish allergy flags — can you confirm plated vs buffet safe-handling practices?
- Cribs/cots: yes confirm 4 cribs.
- Early breakfast boxes: confirm 12 boxes to be delivered to the hotel loading dock at 5:45am on 11/16.
- Resort fee waiver: please attempt to get the waiver for the 4 executive rooms; if they require an F&B minimum, outline expected threshold.

Also flagging: Dev, please prepare a preliminary shuttle manifest template (name, arrival time, pick-up location, phone) and a separate accessibility-room list with guest flags so we can communicate to the hotel discreetly.

Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, People Ops, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna@acmeevents.com>, Hilton Sales <hilton-sales@hilton.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2027 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hotel block details, late arrivals, and special-request rollup

Jenna — thanks for the fast turnaround and the rate confirmation. Action items and decisions from our side: 

1) Master bill recipient: "Acme Financial Services LLP" will be the primary master-bill entity for room nights and contracted line items; Redwood will accept incidentals and any card-not-present charges. Please reflect this on the DocuSign addendum.

2) ADA & exec rooms: lock the 3 guaranteed ADA rooms in the main tower and hold 2 overflow accessible rooms. Reserve the CEO-adjacent suite for 11/15–11/17 and hold the quiet-floor allocation of 6 rooms.

3) Laundry: go ahead with consolidated pickup on 11/16 billed to master at the flat $18/bag estimate; we will capture final counts at check-in.

4) Cribs/cots: pre-place 4; bill to master.

5) Early breakfasts: 12 boxed breakfasts delivered to loading dock at 5:45am on 11/16.

6) Shuttle: confirm two dedicated vans at 7:10am and 7:55am; Dev will send the manifest.

Attached is the guest preference form we will circulate to employees (redwood_guest_preferences_form.pdf). Dev: please compile the shuttle manifest and the accessibility list and add it to the shared drive link Jenna provided. Laura: can you confirm who on the Acme travel side will receive final guest rooming data (and any NDA constraints)?

If DocuSign is ready I will countersign once the master bill entity is updated.

Thanks all — tight timeline but looks good.

Ben
Head of Events, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_guest_preferences_form.pdf
